phases.summary: Tools, GitHub CLI scopes, installer dry run, build.config.yml.

steps.title: Tool versions
steps.detail: git, gh, node, npm, python, uv, sf (+ code-analyzer), claude, openssl, jq, actionlint, specify. Recorded in build-state.md.

result.text: git 2.53.0, gh 2.73.0, node 22.23.3, npm 10.9.9, python 3.13.1, uv 0.13.0, sf 2.157.8 (code-analyzer 5.1.0), claude 2.1.318, openssl 3.5.5, jq 1.7.1, actionlint 1.7.7, specify 1.3.4

steps.title: GitHub CLI and your access
steps.detail: gh auth status needs scopes repo, admin:org, workflow; you need to be an org owner or repo admin.

result.text: gh token lacks admin:org: run gh auth refresh -s admin:org,workflow
lines: gh: signed in; scopes repo, workflow

steps.title: Installer dry run
steps.detail: Shows what install.mjs would add, update or skip. Changes nothing.

steps.title: Fill build.config.yml
steps.detail: Org, repo, people per team, Jira, Confluence, Salesforce URLs, Slack. No secrets.

result.text: Still empty: people.architects, people.developers, people.testers, jira.site

steps.title: Sign in to every service in your browser
steps.detail: Sign in once so the later screens open directly.

checklist.text: Signed in to GitHub with an org owner account
Signed in to Atlassian (Jira and Confluence)
Signed in to the DEV and QA orgs
Signed in to Slack

phases.name: GitHub org and bot
phases.summary: Teams, labels, GitHub App, secrets, variables, production environment.

steps.title: Persona teams
steps.detail: Creates architects, developers, testers (closed), adds the people from build.config.yml, gives each team push on the repo. Teams must be disjoint.

steps.title: Labels
steps.detail: sdd, needs-clarification, plan-review, plan-approved, testplan-approved, ai-ready, ai-generated, ai-attempt-1..3, needs-human, needs-qa.

result.text: Missing labels: plan-approved, testplan-approved, ai-ready, needs-human, needs-qa

steps.title: GitHub App for CI
steps.detail: Create the App in the browser, install it on this repo only, then store its id and private key below.

checklist.text: No webhook
Repository permissions: Contents RW, Pull requests RW, Issues RW, Actions Read, Commit statuses RW, Metadata Read
Organization permissions: Members Read
Workflows: no access
Private key generated
Installed on this repository only

steps.title: App secrets
steps.detail: APP_ID from the App page; APP_PRIVATE_KEY from the downloaded .pem (deleted afterwards if you agree).

steps.title: Claude token for CI (subscription seat)
steps.detail: On the dedicated CI seat run claude setup-token (1-year token), then store it as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Never ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

checklist.text: Signed in as the dedicated CI seat
Token copied from the terminal, not pasted anywhere else

steps.title: Repository variables
steps.detail: MAX_AI_ATTEMPTS, SF_INSTANCE_URL_SANDBOX, SF_INSTANCE_URL_PROD, SF_AI_TESTER_IN_CI, SF_AI_TESTER_REF, SF_AI_TESTER_MODE from build.config.yml.

steps.title: Environment production
steps.detail: Creates the production environment (reviewers are added in B9).

phases.name: Salesforce access
phases.summary: DEV and QA integration users with JWT; production by a person (HC-5).

steps.title: Org aliases dev and qa
steps.detail: sf org display for both aliases (read-only).

steps.title: Key pairs
steps.detail: Creates dev.key/dev.crt and qa.key/qa.crt in ~/.sfkeys with openssl (730 days). Existing keys are kept.

steps.title: Integration users and External Client Apps (DEV and QA)
steps.detail: Per sandbox: user ai-dev / ai-qa, permission set, External Client App with JWT and the .crt. You handle licence and MFA prompts.

checklist.text: ai-dev: API, read, run tests, check-only deploys; nothing else
ai-qa: deploy, run tests, test-data DML
External Client App: OAuth, JWT bearer, .crt uploaded, admin-approved users pre-authorised
Consumer keys copied

steps.title: DEV and QA secrets
steps.detail: Client ids and usernames typed; JWT keys picked from ~/.sfkeys (deleted afterwards if you agree; keep the .crt).

steps.title: Production access (a person only)
steps.detail: The person with production rights follows docs/prod-access-steps.md and stores the three PROD secrets on the production environment. This extension never logs in to production.

checklist.text: Release user with deploy rights only
External Client App with its own certificate
Secrets stored on the production environment, not the repo

phases.name: Repo foundation
phases.summary: Installer on pipeline/foundation; persona MCP URLs; PR merged by a person.
phases.notes: not pushed: no GitHub repo yet; workflows held for B8; MCP URLs still VERIFY

steps.title: Branch pipeline/foundation
steps.detail: git switch -c pipeline/foundation (or switch to it).

steps.title: Run the installer
steps.detail: install.mjs for real: CLAUDE.md, .claude/, CODEOWNERS, PR template, scripts/ci, .coderabbit.yaml, sf-config, workflows. Existing files are skipped.

steps.title: Persona MCP URLs
steps.detail: Replaces VERIFY placeholders in .claude/personas/*.mcp.json with the verified vendor URLs (Atlassian v2, Lucid, Fireflies, GitHub, Slack).

steps.title: Commit, push and merge the foundation PR
steps.detail: Commit everything except .github/workflows/, push pipeline/foundation, open the PR. A person merges it.

checklist.text: Committed without .github/workflows/
PR opened
PR merged by a person

phases.name: Spec Kit
phases.summary: specify init + spec-kit-sf v2.0.1; deploy skills removed; constitution.
phases.notes: deploy/hotfix/pr skills removed; constitution not yet generated

steps.title: specify init
steps.detail: specify init --here --integration claude --integration-options=--no-model-invocation

steps.title: spec-kit-sf extension
steps.detail: specify extension add sf --from the v2.0.1 release archive (confirm the URL in the terminal).

steps.title: Remove deploy skills
steps.detail: Deletes .claude/skills/speckit-sf-deploy, -hotfix and -pr (the guard blocks them anyway).

steps.title: Spec Kit state
steps.detail: .specify/, extension sf, sf-config prod: "none", constitution present.

steps.title: Constitution
steps.detail: An Architect runs /speckit-sf-constitution against dev and appends the house rules as Article X; the Architect reviews and merges the PR.

checklist.text: Constitution generated
Article X added
PR merged by the Architect

phases.name: Jira
phases.summary: Service account, groups, fields, workflow, automation rules, GitHub for Jira.

steps.title: Jira service account token
steps.detail: Create the API token for delivery-bot and store it with the site URL and the bot email.

checklist.text: Token created while signed in as the service account
Service account has project access

steps.title: Groups, project, fields, workflow
steps.detail: Groups architects/developers/testers; company-managed project; custom fields; workflow with restricted transitions (Design Approved: architects; Ready for Dev: testers + Testability confirmed).

checklist.text: Fields: Spec file, Feature, Story type, Schema change, Persona, Test level, AC id, Testability confirmed, Acceptance criteria
Statuses Backlog to Done in order
Design Review to Design Approved: architects only
Design Approved to Ready for Dev: testers only

steps.title: Automation rules A and B
steps.detail: Rule A posts repository_dispatch with the key only; the fine-grained PAT goes into its header, typed by you. Rule B syncs statuses from the bot's comments.

checklist.text: Rule A: trigger Ready for Dev, conditions ai-ready + Testability + blockers Done
Rule A: POST /repos/<org>/<repo>/dispatches with {event_type: jira-ready, client_payload: {key}}
Rule A: then transition to Plan Review
Rule B rows for every bot comment

steps.title: GitHub for Jira
steps.detail: Install the GitHub for Jira app and connect the organisation.

checklist.text: App installed on the org
Org connected in Jira

steps.title: Discover Jira ids
steps.detail: jira-sync.mjs discover writes .specify/extensions/jira/jira-config.json (your Jira credentials are passed through the environment).

phases.name: Dry run
phases.summary: Whole circuit on a made-up feature with people at every gate (HC-9).

steps.title: Dry-run settings
steps.detail: DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT=production-dryrun (environment holding QA secrets under the PROD names) and AI_LOOP_DRY_RUN=false.

steps.title: Run the circuit end to end
steps.detail: Push inputs/transcripts/000-sample-case-escalation.md on intake/sample and take it through every gate.

checklist.text: spec-gate red until G1 by an architect
Jira epic, Story 00, stories; second push creates nothing
Test cases per AC linked in Jira
Rule A fires only after Story 00 Done and G2
Draft PR has only PLAN.md and TESTPLAN.md
Build starts only after both labels by the right teams
Removing a TC reference fails static
Forced failure: 3 attempts then needs-human
Blocked AI-tester case gives needs-qa
Merge is architect-only; deploy waits for approval

steps.title: Clean up
steps.detail: Sets DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT back (removes the variable). Close dry-run issues and delete branches yourself; keep the PRs.
